command:
set -eu
export PATH=/nix/var/rooms/env/bin:$PATH
mkdir -p /tmp/swarm /workspace/out
cd /tmp/swarm
python3 -c "import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlretrieve('http://192.168.5.15:37769/swarm','swarm')"
chmod +x swarm
ID=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)
KIND=task
if [ $((0x$(printf %s "$ID" | cut -c1))) -lt 8 ]; then KIND=event; fi
./swarm plane worker '{"Store":"resp:192.168.5.15:39167/rooms:","Kind":"","Incarnation":"","TTL":2000000000,"Poll":100000000,"WorkMin":200000000,"WorkMax":200000000,"Seed":0,"CrashProb":0,"SplitEvery":7,"StopWhenDry":true,"Seats":false,"Broken":{"NoEpochCheck":false,"NoDoneCheck":false,"NoPendingCheck":false,"NoIdempotency":false,"EpochReuse":false}}' --incarnation "$ID" --kind "$KIND" > /workspace/out/peer.log 2>&1
